Important Information

We are proud to be back. As the official video team of WBO, we have been accompanying Topmodel of the World and Miss Intercontinental for several editions now — and we are excited to once again be part of this journey with you in Egypt.

Throughout the competition, we will be capturing the event cinematically. The scheduled shoots in your program are part of the production process for our final films, which will be presented on the big screen during the finale.

Most importantly: everyone is being filmed throughout the competition — no one is intentionally left out. At the same time, each of us creates an individual author film, which means the final selection of scenes and moments remains part of our creative process. Raw footage is not distributed separately.

Due to the many requests we received during previous editions, we are now officially offering Private Sessions — dedicated one-on-one shoots where one of us focuses entirely on you, creating an exclusive cinematic video at a location of your choice.

We are three videographers — Arafan, Serge and Max — and each of us has a limited number of available slots.

Below you will find a small portfolio from each videographer. Take a moment to explore all three and choose the style that resonates with you most.
